title: Replace current game with an original Teen Patti–style card game (no real-money gambling)

requirements.text: Replace the current primary app experience (Sky Dodge / OriginalGameShell) with a new, original Teen Patti–style card game experience (Teen Patti-like gameplay), keeping the app mobile-first and playable in the browser as a PWA.

quotes: Maine game banvani teen patti game jaisi ab banaa kar do sab de sakte ho mujhe

acceptanceCriteria: Opening the app no longer shows the Sky Dodge canvas game; it shows the new Teen Patti–style game start screen.
The game runs fully in-browser with touch-friendly controls and responsive layout for mobile portrait.
No third-party/copyrighted card artwork or branded assets are used in the new game.

requirements.text: Implement a complete Teen Patti–style gameplay loop with clear English UI: Start screen → start a hand → deal cards → player actions (at minimum: Fold, Call/Check, Raise) → opponent actions (simple AI) → showdown → win/lose result → play again.

quotes: Maine game banvani teen patti game jaisi ab banaa kar do sab de sakte ho mujhe

acceptanceCriteria: A user can start a new hand from the start screen and complete a full hand to a clear result (win/lose) without errors.
During a hand, the user can always choose Fold, and at least one non-fold betting action (Call/Check) and one increase action (Raise).
After the hand ends, the UI shows the outcome and provides a clearly labeled English action to play the next hand.

requirements.text: Design the Teen Patti–style game to be clearly non-gambling: use play chips only, do not include any real-money wording, cashout, deposits, wallets, or monetization claims; include an English disclaimer in the game UI that it is for entertainment with no real-money gambling.
acceptanceCriteria: All currency is presented as 'chips' (or equivalent play currency) with no references to real money.
An in-app English disclaimer is visible from an info/help/legal area stating the game is for entertainment only and involves no real-money gambling.
There are no UI elements for payments, withdrawals, deposits, or betting with real money.

requirements.text: Create original, lightweight card-table visuals suitable for the Teen Patti–style game (table surface, card back, chip icon) as static assets stored under frontend/public/assets/generated, and render them in the game UI.
acceptanceCriteria: All newly created images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and are loaded directly by the frontend (not via the backend).
The Teen Patti–style game UI uses the generated assets (table/background styling, card back design, and chip icon) in a cohesive way.
The app builds without missing-asset errors (no 404s for required generated images).

requirements.text: Update app naming and user-facing text to match the new Teen Patti–style game (English only): update the header title currently showing 'Sky Dodge', and update the PWA manifest name/description to reflect the new card game.
acceptanceCriteria: The in-app header no longer says 'Sky Dodge' and instead uses the new Teen Patti–style game name (English).
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest no longer describes Sky Dodge; it describes the new card game and remains a valid PWA manifest JSON.
All user-facing text changed/introduced by this request is in English.

requirements.text: Update the in-app help/about/legal content to match the new Teen Patti–style card game and the user's request for ownership/access: clearly state (English) that the project includes original assets and that the user has full access to the source code and included assets in this project.
acceptanceCriteria: The help/about/legal content no longer describes Sky Dodge gameplay.
The content includes an English statement that the project source code and included original assets are available to the user within the project.
The content does not promise Play Store publishing, monetization integrations, or real-money gambling functionality.

constraints: Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for all user-facing text.
All assets used for the Teen Patti–style game must be original (no copied/trademarked card decks, casino brands, or third-party artwork).
nonGoals: Implementing real-money gambling features (deposits/withdrawals/cash games) or any payments integration.
Multiplayer over the network or real-time play with other users.
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported, but not required for this change).
Creating or integrating a backend database or external storage for player accounts/chips.
